schemaNotes.description: request.query contains documented SDK operation parameters, not an assertion about HTTP wire query serialization. DescribeCanaries and DescribeAlarms use POST.
CanaryCodeInput is separately supplied local input, never a field returned inside GetCanary.Code. ZIP packages are deterministic synthetic files. Code references are not fetched.
Dummy account 000000000000 and reserved targets only. IAM/KMS/S3/Lambda/SNS identifiers remain inert source metadata.
